panels.title: Obecność domowników
panels.description: Kto był w domu (z przedziałów obecności).

targets.queryText:
SELECT time, person, home FROM (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%s', i.start_ts) AS INTEGER), $__from / 1000) AS time, p.name AS person, 1 AS home
  FROM presence_intervals i JOIN persons p ON p.id = i.person_id
  WHERE i.start_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND (i.end_ts IS NULL OR i.end_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', i.end_ts) AS INTEGER) AS time, p.name AS person, 0 AS home
  FROM presence_intervals i JOIN persons p ON p.id = i.person_id
  WHERE i.end_ts IS NOT NULL AND i.end_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND i.end_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__to / 1000 AS time, p.name AS person, 1 AS home
  FROM presence_intervals i JOIN persons p ON p.id = i.person_id
  WHERE i.end_ts IS NULL AND i.start_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
)
ORDER BY time, person, home

targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', e.ts) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  p.name AS "Osoba",
  CASE e.kind WHEN 'arrive' THEN 'Przyjście' ELSE 'Wyjście' END AS "Zdarzenie",
  COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, e.mac) AS "Urządzenie"
FROM presence_events e
JOIN persons p ON p.id = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = e.mac
WHERE e.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND e.ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Typowa obecność w tygodniu (%)
panels.description: Mapa cieplna profilu: średni odsetek godziny spędzonej w domu, wg dnia tygodnia i godziny czasu lokalnego (Europe/Warsaw).

targets.queryText:
SELECT p.name AS "Osoba",
  CASE pr.weekday WHEN 0 THEN 'Pn' WHEN 1 THEN 'Wt' WHEN 2 THEN 'Śr' WHEN 3 THEN 'Cz'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Pt' WHEN 5 THEN 'So' ELSE 'Nd' END AS "Dzień",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 0 THEN pr.value END)) AS "00",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 1 THEN pr.value END)) AS "01",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 2 THEN pr.value END)) AS "02",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 3 THEN pr.value END)) AS "03",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 4 THEN pr.value END)) AS "04",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 5 THEN pr.value END)) AS "05",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 6 THEN pr.value END)) AS "06",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 7 THEN pr.value END)) AS "07",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 8 THEN pr.value END)) AS "08",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 9 THEN pr.value END)) AS "09",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 10 THEN pr.value END)) AS "10",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 11 THEN pr.value END)) AS "11",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 12 THEN pr.value END)) AS "12",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 13 THEN pr.value END)) AS "13",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 14 THEN pr.value END)) AS "14",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 15 THEN pr.value END)) AS "15",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 16 THEN pr.value END)) AS "16",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 17 THEN pr.value END)) AS "17",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 18 THEN pr.value END)) AS "18",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 19 THEN pr.value END)) AS "19",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 20 THEN pr.value END)) AS "20",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 21 THEN pr.value END)) AS "21",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 22 THEN pr.value END)) AS "22",
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN pr.hour = 23 THEN pr.value END)) AS "23"
FROM profiles pr
JOIN persons p ON CAST(pr.subject_id AS INTEGER) = p.id
WHERE pr.subject_type = 'person_home'
GROUP BY p.name, pr.weekday
ORDER BY p.name, pr.weekday
